description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'BasicDisplayField' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. The class implements the 'DisplayField' interface and provides a constructor and some abstract and concrete methods related to report display fields in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: BasicDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract class representing a basic display field for reports, providing methods to get entity alias, field name, and select part of a database query.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Final constructor method to initialize the BasicDisplayField class.

methods.name: getEntityAlias
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the alias of the entity associated with this display field.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the specific field name associated with this display field.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL select part string combining entity alias and field.
